verified_source_properties: Four templates were hash-pinned and independently reproduced exactly by the owner.
Selection uses actual phase, nearest center, a 1e-12 rad tie tolerance and lower phase index on ties. Exact zero yaw gives zero action; no start-label lookup selects the action.
The vector stays fixed for five ticks. Both signs at amplitudes 0.025 and 0.05 are applied after policy-action clipping; actual coordinate doses and clipping are recorded.
Four continuous baselines match the reviewed source bank in full state, trace and observed yaw before any branches.
Eight zero branches pass complete state and trace parity before 32 pulse branches. Every pulse prefix is checked.
Decision uses 5 mrad actual positive-vector gain plus unchanged corrected retention, positive odd response, both starts, opposite-vector retention and each yaw sign.
One global dose is selected, preferring 0.025. Stronger bidirectional reversal is reported separately. Discovery results do not authorize PPO.

findings.detail: No concrete implementation or gate defect found. Frozen templates, action timing, exact prefix/zero state checks and global-dose predicates agree with guidance. Independently recomputed raw yaw/retention/template qualification agrees with owner analysis.

At amplitude 0.05, only negative-yaw phase 0 qualifies across both starts, with gains 7.0659 and 5.6659 mrad. No positive-yaw template qualifies. At 0.025, no template qualifies. Four of 16 positive-vector cases pass 5 mrad plus retention; 15/16 have the expected odd direction; 30/32 pulse branches retain. The two retention failures are positive-yaw phase 1 at 0.05: forward ratios 0.85424 and 0.89082, below 0.9. No clipping occurred. The stronger bidirectional 5 mrad reversal count is 0/16.

The coordinated response is measurable but fails the frozen both-signs/global-dose criterion. Conditional quarter-phase and straight tests are not licensed; neither is PPO. Preserve the original 0/288 single-joint negative and avoid universal closure of coordinated, longer or closed-loop steering classes.
